page.content:
Northeastern French region whose name is the sparkling wine.

How Champagne connects

  • Topic: Old World wine — Champagne is an Old World sparkling appellation and method.
  • Topic: Traditional method — Champagne is made by the traditional method of bottle fermentation.
  • Item: Pinot Noir — Pinot Noir is one of Champagne's three permitted grapes.
  • Item: Chardonnay — Chardonnay is a pillar of Champagne blends and blanc de blancs.

What is Champagne?

Champagne is both place and method: Pinot and Chardonnay (and Meunier) refermented in bottle, an AOC so famous that other bubbles must pick another word.

Key threads lead to Old World wine, Traditional method, Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.
